review_policy: Review changed behavior against all GitHub Actions workflow scripts, all Dart and Python QA test files, and the original tests' protected security assertions; never edit tests merely to silence red jobs.

contracts.previous_behavior: Opening the 1000-message sheet reprocessed the entire owner-encrypted review queue and expensive sender grouping.
contracts.approved_behavior: Open verified snapshot promptly, build stable sender grouping in a linear pass, preserve selection, user confirmation and all finance verification gates.
safety_invariants: Never post income or expense from merely loading or grouping the review queue.
Keep original SMS IDs, encrypted owner consent, sender selection and data intact.

contracts.previous_behavior: Fresh-account enrollment duplicated an expensive password KDF verification and navigation waited on nonessential review refreshes.
contracts.approved_behavior: Use authenticated one-pass fresh verifier persistence with existing signed-in password requirements unchanged; show progress immediately and avoid frame blocking.
safety_invariants: Never permit login with an incorrect password or bypass biometric/session ownership.
Preserve existing SQLCipher protected user data and recovery credentials.

contracts.previous_behavior: An older native financial-only SMS qualification filter excluded personal and unknown senders; repeated bulk exclusions re-parsed 1000 message bodies and asked a sender dialog for each group. Earlier M470 QA still demanded one sender dialog per group and old literal 100-ID loop variable names.
contracts.approved_behavior: All eligible SMS inbox senders enter review only; 1000 selected messages can be excluded after one user choice; blocking senders keeps only encrypted names; durable cursor prevents replay; Rescan dims without unseen messages. Keep M470 tests aligned with one global sender choice, idempotent 100-ID batches for individual exclusions, and no pre-confirmation parse.
safety_invariants: Never delete Android Messages inbox or confirmed SQLCipher finance entries.
OTP numbers must be masked; owner, committed, excluded and transfer fingerprints prevent replay and double charge.
No background SMS receiver gains financial ledger or cloud posting authority.

contracts.previous_behavior: Obsolete source-text tests were discovered only after expensive Android/Flutter workflow failures; the new sender restore condition also missed a closing Kotlin parenthesis.
contracts.approved_behavior: Mandatory early exact-head preflight inventories every workflow job and test, reports affected behavior and stale positive assertions, requires an updated human-reviewed contract for each changed production source, and corrects the Kotlin syntax independently.
safety_invariants: Never skip or rewrite finance and security tests to force a green build.
Kotlin and Flutter compilation must still run on the exact PR commit.
A source-level audit is not proof of device performance or correct business semantics.

contracts.issue: Issues #493 and #494 (approved compact Home and native notification review)
contracts.previous_behavior: Home displayed an oversized balance with account dropdown inside the card and separate redundant income/expense metric blocks plus a standalone SMS review card. Notification access did not directly expose the verified pending review queue.
contracts.approved_behavior: Match the approved compact Arabic RTL Home: separate independently verified month account filter outside balance; preserve stationary floating Add button; three small finance actions go through original guarded income/expense/transfer flows; show a bell with only actual pending SMS (saturating at +999), and open a compact notification center whose review CTA leads to native owner-bound SMS review rather than auto-posting.
safety_invariants: Use actual Android/native pending messages only; never fabricate system alerts or silently post account money.
Keep existing floating + position/size/animation, preserve sender exclusion/OTP masking and SQLCipher account/ledger witness.
The separate #495 first-time last-four/transaction-date/one-tap finance feature remains incomplete; do not claim that this UI change implements it.
Preserve older active owner account balances and confirmation-only transfer/entry gate.

contracts.issue: Issue #495: first-time bank account selection and repeat trusted identity
contracts.previous_behavior: Old bank SMS learning required two confirmations and permitted sender-only shortcuts for unique-bank guesses, then asked for account picker repeatedly.
contracts.approved_behavior: One successfully committed, owner-confirmed sender+exact-four-digit account identity can be reused after fresh encrypted account witness; no sender-only linking or guessing a mismatched suffix.
safety_invariants: Only post after explicit transaction confirmation and existing atomic encrypted SMS hash writer.
Wrong bank, wrong suffix, archived account and sender-only identity must not automatically debit any account.

contracts.previous_behavior: OTP security challenges (notably Arabic temporary code) could leak into money labels; a tapped notice marshalled the entire 1000-SMS encrypted queue, an unchanged Back reprocessed it all; notifications showed duplicate large CTA and old filters; cold Home spinner showed blank content and summary numerals overflowed; submit button visually shrank while secure sign-in ran.
contracts.approved_behavior: Use source-only bilingual OTP verification safety, per-SMS type and redacted review, sender-based direct notification tap with a single verified selected-ID native lookup on the SMS executor, no unconditional 1000-item reread after cancel, live incremental refresh, stable sign-in CTA, a bounded isolated cold Home loading surface, and fitted full currency figures. No automatic SMS deletion or finance posting from preview. Transfer and double-confirm redesign remain pending. M587 presents three explicit transfer preview actions: open guarded confirmed two-account form, add a separately confirmed independent income/expense, or exclude only this SMS. M588 restores the exact main Dart bridge after a real compiler-reported malformed regex insertion; new single-ID fetch retained. M589 keeps compact verified multi-select/bulk exclusions accessible via AppBar action without the redundant hero. M590 labels pending OTP and suggested exclusions as requiring review; only a durably excluded SMS may be described as excluded.
safety_invariants: No OTP/access-code or uncertain-bank message is a settled expense or income; never log real banking SMS or codes.
No user funds move on opening/canceling a notification; the native owner/session and SQLCipher finance writer/hash anti-replay remain fully enforced.
Sender-only assumptions cannot authorize a bank account; no source/destination fee posting from an unverified transfer.
Unmodified sender-bulk exclusion, existing finance records, pinned floating + layout, and spouse-device update/migration remain safe.
These changes need full exact-HEAD Android/Flutter/Python native tests and before/after device frame measurements, and do not claim seven features complete.
Transfer Yes never commits before a second approved verified two-account editor confirmation; No never treats original SMS as posted income or expense, and Exclude never touches Android inbox.
Notifications may never describe a pending SMS or suggested excluded rule as an already excluded message, and the original owner-verified bulk review remains accessible.
